normalized.result: Confirmed. Back in All bookmarks I selected the pasta and presence bookmarks, clicked **Archive selected**, and when I opened the Archive both were there together with everything intact — titles, tags, addresses, notes. Meanwhile the focused-work bookmark I hadn't selected stayed put in my active library. So archiving a batch moves exactly the ones I picked and leaves the rest alone, same as archiving one at a time did earlier, just faster. That's what I wanted from bulk archiving. Good.
